visibility.label: Who can see this
visibility.p1: Published profiles (capabilities, levels, status, statements) are visible to the employee, their reporting managers, and organization admins. Supporting notes and restricted self-reports are visible to the employee and reporting managers. Drafts are visible only to the employee.
visibility.p2: Viewing a profile does not notify the employee or leave a log. Publishing a direct edit notifies the employee.
visibility.p3: After offboarding, profiles and self-reports are archived read-only: only organization admins can see archived capabilities, levels, and statuses; restricted self-reports and manager review comments are hidden even from admins who also serve as department managers. When an account is disabled, open requests are withdrawn automatically; if reactivated, visibility follows active rules and withdrawn requests are not restored.
visibility.p4: Data is stored on servers deployed by your organization. Contact your organization admin for storage location, backup, and retention details.
